title: Devastator — The Capture of Tantive IV
description: A panelled Imperial dagger with continuous diagonal wing edges, an open framed machinery trench, bevelled armour, an illuminated ventral capture bay, eight twin turbolaser batteries, a chamfered command tower and seven octagonal exhausts. Tantive IV and two TIE escorts remain suspended on compact independent cradles.

sections.name: Interlocked hollow dagger and bevelled underside
Continuous diagonal armour edges and trench frames
Low pitch armour planes and individual panels
Chamfered command citadel and panoramic bridge
Shield globes aerial and service ducts
Three main drives and four auxiliary exhausts
